name: Devansh Soriano-Srisai-Anang

description:
Devansh Soriano-Srisai-Anang in the Grind layer of the Gray Zone, son of a cargo platform supervisor who drank himself to death after a Kessler-Dyne automation wave eliminated his entire shift. Marcus inherited two things: his father's loading dock connections and his father's conviction that the world owes you nothing and you take what you can carry. He built the Lower Dock Crew from six displaced cargo workers who realized that controlling dock access was more profitable than working the docks. He has a seven-year-old son named Eli who lives with Marcus's ex-partner, Danae, three tiers up. Marcus sends money every week. He has never missed a payment. He tells himself the crew is how he provides. The truth is more complicated.

Kyle removed his right arm at the shoulder socket. The replacement is a Tier 1 surplus unit that clicks when he extends it and has a two-second lag on fine motor control. He has chrome-plated it because Marcus Bellamy has always believed that looking strong and being strong are the same thing. They are not. He is learning this slowly.

He keeps upgrading after every encounter with Kyle â€” more chrome, better hardware, heavier plating. It never helps. He is a man trying to solve a software problem with hardware, and the recurring joke of his appearances is that each time he has less original biology and more machine, and each time it matters less.

His crew seeing him as weak
core_desires: To provide for Eli without Eli knowing how
Revenge he knows he cannot get

blind_spots: More chrome makes him a bigger target, not a harder one

psychology.secret: The Morozov beating was ordered by someone above him. A Tessera middle manager named Oren Falk. Marcus was the tool, not the hand. He has never told his crew this.

example_lines: Next time's different. *click* ...I'm getting that calibrated.
Eli asked me why my arm sounds like a stapler. I told him it's a feature. He didn't believe me. Kid's too smart.

relationships.name: Eli Bellamy
relationships.description: Seven years old. Lives with Danae three tiers up. Marcus lives for the weekly payment and the biweekly visit. Eli is already asking questions Marcus cannot answer.
relationships.emotional_core: The only clean thing in his life
relationships.story_tension: If the crew falls apart, the payments stop. If the payments stop, Marcus has no reason to pretend he's not a bad person.

relationships.name: Danae Osei
relationships.description: Left Marcus when the crew started. She was right to leave. Marcus knows this. He sends money and does not ask to come back.
relationships.story_tension: Danae knows about Kyle. She told Marcus to stop. He didn't listen.

relationships.name: Kyle
relationships.description: Kyle does not think about Marcus. Marcus thinks about Kyle every day.
relationships.story_tension: Every reappearance is funnier and sadder.

relationships.name: Oren Falk
relationships.description: Tessera middle manager who ordered the Morozov beating. Marcus takes orders. Marcus does not ask why.
relationships.story_tension: If Kyle traces the beating back to Falk, Marcus becomes a loose end.

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora blend with Southeast Asian (34.8%) as the foundational bone structure, substantially modified by Indigenous American (28.7%) and Hispanic/Latin American (21.9%) heritage that broadens his face and softens angularity. Sub-Saharan African ancestry (10.0%) deepens his skin tone to rich warm brown and contributes to eye depth and fuller lip structure. Eastern European traces (4.6%) add subtle angular definition to his jawline and orbital structure. The result is a genuinely multi-continental face that reads as no single origin â€” higher Southeast Asian cheekbones softened by broader Indigenous American facial width, warm golden-brown skin with Sub-Saharan depth, and fuller lips characteristic of Latin American and African heritage.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and muscular but running to seed â€” the kind of strength that's already starting to soften at the middle from lack of sleep and too much stimulant coffee. His left arm is dense with functional muscle; his right side is all hardware.
physical_description.hair_style: Short, unkempt. He cuts it himself with a dull blade.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, bloodshot from chronic sleep debt
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm tan â€” the blended result of Southeast Asian base, enriched and darkened by Indigenous American, Latin American, and Sub-Saharan African ancestry. Golden undertones catch light across cheekbones and jaw, creating a complexion that reads as genuinely multi-continental rather than any single origin.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined with fine creasing that speaks to mixed heritage and hard living. Three-day stubble is his default. Stress has carved permanent grooves from nose to mouth. His features carry Southeast Asian bone structure â€” higher cheekbones, slightly angular eye set â€” substantially broadened and softened by Indigenous American and Latin American influences, with Sub-Saharan African heritage deepening his complexion and contributing to fuller lips and slightly wider orbital spacing. His face is broader and rounder than pure Southeast Asian, with the characteristic lip fullness of African and Latin American ancestry. The gauntness of sleep deprivation pulls these features taut. His jaw is subtly swollen along the left side where sub-dermal plating sits just beneath the skin â€” visible as a faint metallic sheen under harsh light.
distinguishing_marks: Jagged scar running from right shoulder blade down to mid-back, puckered and white â€” artifact of the amputation and crude emergency suturing
Burn scar across the inside of his left forearm, old and faded, from a childhood dock accident
Tattoo on his left pectoral: a stylized anchor with his son's name 'ELI' inked below in block letters, done in a back-room parlor on Tier 4
Thin white line bisecting his left eyebrow â€” a blade fight at age nineteen
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome-plated right arm replacement ending in a functional but crude servo hand. The plating is aggressively polished, catching light. A faint clicking and whirring audible when he extends it. Sub-dermal jaw plating visible as a metallic sheen along the left mandible, most obvious in profile or under LED lighting. Chrome-knuckle reinforcement on his remaining left hand â€” four small chrome caps over the metacarpal joints, dull with frequent impact scarring. Left knee brace visible beneath clothing when he moves â€” a bulky aftermarket rig with visible struts and synthetic muscle fibers.
physical_description.posture_movement: He moves like someone who's always half-ready for a fight â€” shoulders slightly tensed, weight favoring his left side to compensate for the arm lag. His gait has a subtle hitch on the left (the knee). When he sits, his right arm rests awkwardly because the servo hand doesn't relax naturally. He has a habit of clenching and unclenching his left fist. His eyes scan rooms. He doesn't blink enough.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian with aspirational chrome touches. Heavy canvas work pants with reinforced pockets, synthetic blend cargo vest over a black compression shirt that shows his arm scars. Steel-toed boots, scuffed but maintained. A long coat â€” synthetic leather, weather-beaten â€” that he wears even in the climate-controlled the Gray Zone because it hides the arm. No jewelry except a faded wedding band on his left ring finger that he doesn't talk about. Everything worn, patched, but kept functional.
